keyword_interpretation.meaning: A quiet invitation that attracts viewer attention through a recipient-directed offer, gaze and proximity. It is not a user definition or fixed visual bundle.

concept.title: 마지막 무화과, 문을 닫기 전에
concept.description: Rainy closing-time neighborhood café, a newly authored 28-year-old adult woman offers the viewer the last fig half with lingering eye contact and a private uneven smile. Warm wall light, cool rain-beaded doorway, cleared table and stacked chairs make an ending visible.

source_ownership.requesting_user: The unchanged current raw request and prior same-method context; independent concept/case/prompt/image evaluation using supplied portrait.
source_ownership.coordinator: Broad experimental topic and face/hair-only reference-use scope.
source_ownership.reference_image: Only directly observed face and hair cues; never adult age or personality.
source_ownership.agent: Adult age 28, café, clothing, fig offer, gesture, gaze, expression, framing, light, narrative and evaluation criteria.
source_ownership.data: None accessed yet; later actual exposure/adoption must be reported separately.

procedural_deviations: Neutral catalog was read before the full material concept comparison was written; cannot establish strict theme-before-catalog ordering. No forbidden candidate or profile access occurred before freeze.

observable_case_gates.criterion: Visible short dark bob, fine fringe, brown eyes and rounded face contour remain recognizably grounded in the supplied face/hair reference; body, age and personality are newly authored.
Subject eyes direct toward viewer and one hand offers an identifiable fig half toward viewer; the bodily offer and eye contact jointly make recipient attention visible.
Private small uneven smile with slightly parted lips and conversational proximity supports an inviting attraction; it need not be overt sexuality or a particular outfit.
Two hands connect plausibly to own forearms, right hand holds fig, left supports saucer, with separated clear object contact.
Cleared table/stacked chairs and rain-beaded glass are visible enough to place the invitation in a closing-time café.
Subject gaze first and offered fruit second remain readable; room supports rather than eclipses the invitation.

focal_coverage_review.reason: Current requester asks to repeat the experiment method; alluring is coordinator topic and all particular realizations are agent-owned. It is tracked by authored case criteria without promoting it into required requester assertion.

required_render_policy: partial_is_fail for actual required/selected data hard gates; authored case observations separate from user acceptance
data_accounting_rule: Report profile and slot candidates separately; original baseline forms never count as newly added DATA. Selecting none is valid.
